items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. So he was responsible for that. ... Taught me how to keep my fingers on the keyboard, on the strings, when I'm picking, in order to get that full tone.

ctx.x: Who was most helpful to you in string bass?
Well, starting out I'd say Wellman Braud, , Duke's bass player with his first band.
Uh-huh. You'd said something about he taught you to --
